purpose: Fixed retrospective screening/internal-resonance information and declared-span-independent scalar contrast. No QSL classifier, state repair, new training, draws, H or amplitude queries.
quality_rule: absolute fixed latest difference > sum of both own frozen quality ranges + Bonferroni normal threshold times independent whole-chain SE. One family: two readouts x three geometries x coupling/cross-method contrasts. Empirical ranges are not certified bias bounds; JK does not remove nonlinear entropy/ratio bias.
operator_scope: Ordered-three-spin pseudoscalars, not necessarily elementary triangular plaquettes. Raw product and high remainder both retained. High remainder independent only of specified linear pair/two-bond/p(q) span, not all conventional observables or a fitted maximum-entropy model.
